lines.name: Boulevard Line
lines.beyond: south to Southside: through-running; second terminus and depot off-sheet

lines.name: Skyport Line
lines.beyond: west to the West End along Circus Road

notes: Kept T1 and S1, re-listed with order [trunk, loop]. Checked by hand only; the plan checker has not been run. T1 trunk runs in the Boulevard (28 m, x 0) and leaves the south sheet edge. The loop joins both tracks (±1.8) at z -56; fillets are 25 to 28 m (minimum 25) and all fit their segments. The r28 arcs are centred on 0,0, inside the 31 m island.

S1: double trunk at z 0 over Circus Road's median, the circus island, Crown Parade (mall), Harbour Road (24 m span on the median) and the Skyport Pier. The loop runs over water with r40 fillets (minimum 40) at ±3 m, stays inside x 740 and closes on the trunk end at x 560. It is two-way, as tide asked.

Rejected tide's Sky Loop round the district. A ring over the primary-road medians needs r70 or more at four right-angle corners. A 90° r70 fillet cuts in about 29 m, past the 12 m road half-width, so it passes over built plots (fails S-C1 and the pylon zones). The straight trunk does the job with no rule failures.

Rejected T2 on Harbour Road. Its south end at z -720 is inside the sheet and needs a loop (T-L1); a loop of r25 or more needs about 50 m and won't fit in a 24 m street. A 90° r50 turn onto Comet Row or Market Street cuts in about 21 m, past the 12 m half-width (fails T-C1). T2 needs a road change first (e.g. a turning space at Harbour Road × Comet Row), a road-plan question for Aster.

Did not extend T1 up Crown Avenue (questions note): the avenue stops at Crown Road (z 280), short of the sheet edge (z 320), so it would need another in-sheet loop. The circus balloon already serves that end.
N-C1: the one interchange is T1 Crown Circus stop (0,-72) with S1 Crown Circus (95,0), about 119 m apart, inside the 150 m limit. Two lines, so that pair is enough.

Source mismatch for Aster: the plan's notes/why still describe the old draft (single-track tram with no loop, a 24 m Sphere loop, a separate Harbour loop). They contradict notes/concept and the current lines; I followed notes/concept.

Reach (250 m) is judged per area. Area centres are within reach, but corner plots at x ±260 (lantern-west, rocket-west, docks-east, harbour-east) are about 270 to 320 m from any stop on these lines. If the checker measures per plot, that is the case for a later east-side tram once the roads allow one.
